exposure: forceps simulation training curriculum for obstetrics residents
cohort: The study involved 6,058 forceps-assisted vaginal deliveries performed over a 10-year period (2.5 years after training and 7.5 years before training).
finding: A forceps simulation curriculum for obstetrics residents was associated with a significant reduction (22-26%) in severe perineal lacerations among women delivered by trained residents.
mod_finding: The study found that resident training in forceps-assisted vaginal delivery was associated with a reduction in severe perineal lacerations after forceps deliveries.
